name: analytics-dashboard-design
description: Build, redesign or critique a product analytics dashboard in a calm, Cloudflare-style layout: KPI row with deltas and sparklines, metric tabs over one chart, a sortable countries table, a website-to-app-to-paid funnel, buyer journeys with timelines, retention cohorts, app health and traffic — with honest numbers, privacy-first tracking and a screenshot QA pass. Distilled from the analytics dashboard of a shipped Mac app.
